name: Hashnode

sources.title: Hashnode homepage — free developer blogging platform, custom domains, GraphQL API, GitHub sync

requirements: Developer/technical orientation — 'the blogging platform for developers and engineers'
preparation: Account; a blog name/subdomain (or a custom domain — Hashnode handles the certificate)
A launch post written as a technical/dev story (markdown editor, syntax highlighting, LaTeX supported)
Optional: connect a GitHub repo — every post/draft mirrors to GitHub
workflow: Create a blog — free at <name>.hashnode.dev or your own custom domain
Write and publish the launch post with product links
Posts enter the Hashnode feed and are reachable on your blog subdomain
Optionally publish programmatically via the GraphQL API (a gql-skill exists for AI agents)
watchFor: Hashnode is a blogging platform — the durable asset is your blog + posts, not a directory row
There's a 'Pro' tier — not needed to publish
Pure promotional posts underperform; frame the launch as a technical write-up
Canonical/custom-domain setup matters if you also publish the same post on your own site
countsAsLive: The blog is public at <name>.hashnode.dev (or custom domain) and the launch post renders to logged-out visitors and in the Hashnode feed
unknowns: Whether post outbound links are dofollow
Whether new blogs appear in the public feed automatically or need engagement signals
